observed: Created an isolated run and preserved the exact supplied source script.
Stopped at an unobserved web.search capability without attempting available tool discovery.
No completed research/script, media, approval or publication.
capture_limits: commands.jsonl contains actual shell commands/stdout/stderr/exit codes captured by the harness, not a model-written trace summary.
Direct web and collaboration calls and progress messages are not captured by the shell wrapper. Source notes and coordinator observations are separate evidence, not a complete raw transcript.
Absolute scratch paths and ephemeral local lease IDs are retained as observed; they grant no access to a production account.
accepted-artifacts contains exact bytes registered in the store. working-artifacts may contain later edits; these are deliberately not substituted for accepted bytes.
